title: The Power Broker #11: Brennan Lee Mulligan

sentences.en: This is the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker.
sentences.zh: 这是《99%隐形》对《权力掮客》的深度解析。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: And I'm Elliot Kalin.
sentences.zh: 我是埃利奥特·卡林。

sentences.en: So today we're continuing part 7, The Loss of Power, chapters 42 through 46.
sentences.zh: 今天我们将继续第七部分“权力的丧失”，即第42章到第46章的内容。

sentences.en: That's pages 984 through 1081.
sentences.zh: 也就是第984页到第1081页。

sentences.en: And later in this episode, our special guest is Brennan Lee Mulligan.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目的后半部分，我们的特邀嘉宾是布伦南·李·穆里根。

sentences.en: Brennan is a comedian and host with Dropout TV, where he's the creator of Dimension 20.
sentences.zh: 布伦南是Dropout TV的喜剧演员兼主持人，也是《Dimension 20》的创作者。

sentences.en: It's a show that features incredibly complex and fun and dynamic Dungeons & Dragons campaigns with improv actors and special effects.
sentences.zh: 这是一档节目，通过即兴表演者和特效，呈现极其复杂、有趣且充满活力的《龙与地下城》战役。

sentences.en: And as the Dungeon Master, Brennan leads these stories.
sentences.zh: 作为地下城主，布伦南引领着这些故事的发展。

sentences.en: And I know that might sound completely unrelated to The Power Broker, but one season of Dimension 20 features a villain that all of you listening would be very familiar with,
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来可能与《权力掮客》完全无关，但《Dimension 20》有一季出现了一个反派，所有听众都会非常熟悉，

sentences.en: but in a very different context.
sentences.zh: 只是背景完全不同。

sentences.en: To my understanding, Mr. Moses is a powerful form of undead.
sentences.zh: 据我理解，摩西先生是一种强大的不死生物。

sentences.en: Robert Moses is a powerful historical figure, never elected, but was part of a lot of government boards, had a lot to do with the building and infrastructure of New York,
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西是一位强大的历史人物，从未经过选举，但曾任职于许多政府委员会，对纽约的建筑和基础设施建设影响巨大，

sentences.en: specifically a lot with the building of roads and highways.
sentences.zh: 特别是在道路和高速公路建设方面。

sentences.en: Causing interference in the magical world.
sentences.zh: 在魔法世界中造成了干扰。

sentences.en: So last time on the 99% Visible Breakdown of the Power Broker,
sentences.zh: 那么，上期《99%隐形》对《权力掮客》的解析中，

sentences.en: Robert Carroll went into incredible detail about how Robert Moses refused to include mass transit as part of his transportation plans.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗极其详尽地讲述了罗伯特·摩西如何拒绝将公共交通纳入其交通规划。

sentences.en: And it doomed New York to a future choked with cars and traffic and really explicit detail about how awful different railroads were.
sentences.zh: 这注定了纽约未来将被汽车和交通拥堵所窒息，书中还非常明确地描述了各种铁路系统是多么糟糕。

sentences.en: It was very vivid,
sentences.zh: 描述非常生动，

sentences.en: but we also saw how an assortment of activists were starting to recognize the serious issues with how Moses was running his slum clearance programs and the public housing construction projects.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到，各种活动家开始意识到摩西在推行贫民窟清理计划和公共住房建设项目时存在严重问题。

sentences.en: So that was a little bit of a glimmer, but there were rumors, rumors of rumors.
sentences.zh: 所以那算是一点点曙光，但当时流言四起，流言的流言也随之而来。

sentences.en: And so on this episode, we'll be covering chapters 42 to 46.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将涵盖第42章到第46章。

sentences.en: That's pages 984 to 1081.
sentences.zh: 也就是第984页到第1081页。

sentences.en: And this is a delightful collection of chapters.
sentences.zh: 这是一组非常精彩的章节。

sentences.en: Elliot.
sentences.zh: 埃利奥特。

sentences.en: These are, especially after the last chapters, which were so gloomy and doomy, this is going to be a nice, yeah,
sentences.zh: 这些章节，特别是在经历了之前那些阴郁沉重的章节之后，感觉会很不错，是的，

sentences.en: this is a nice change of pace because Robert Moses is on the dissension rather than the ascension.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的节奏变化，因为罗伯特·摩西正处于下坡路，而不是上升期。

sentences.en: And it's going to happen in ways that are not entirely satisfying in terms of the scale and scope of the crimes he's being hoisted on.
sentences.zh: 而且这种衰落发生的方式，就他所犯下的罪行规模和范围而言，并不完全令人满意。

sentences.en: The petard he's being hoisted on is not the petard we hoped it would be.
sentences.zh: 他最终自食其果的方式，并不是我们所期待的那种方式。

sentences.en: But there's something fun about that, and Robert Caro is clearly having fun writing about it, and that really comes through.
sentences.zh: 但其中有些有趣之处，罗伯特·卡罗在描写时显然乐在其中，这一点真的表现得很明显。

sentences.en: And by the end of today's episode, Moses will have been hoisted by his own petard.
sentences.zh: 到今天节目结束时，摩西将自食其果。

sentences.en: There's no other way to put it.
sentences.zh: 没有别的说法了。

sentences.en: There's no other way to put it.
sentences.zh: 没有别的说法了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a petard hoisting.
sentences.zh: 这就是自食其果。

sentences.en: It's a classic petard hoisting.
sentences.zh: 这是经典的自食其果。

sentences.en: And as you were saying, we're going to pass the 1,000-page mark in this episode, which is very exciting.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，我们将在本期节目中跨越1000页大关，这非常令人兴奋。

sentences.en: That's a lot of pages, and we'll have to take a moment to pop some champagne, really reminisce about the pages that brought us here.
sentences.zh: 这可是相当多的页数，我们得花点时间开瓶香槟庆祝一下，好好回味一下带我们走到这里的这些篇章。

sentences.en: But it's going to be exciting.
sentences.zh: 但这会很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It's going to be exciting.
sentences.zh: 这会很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: So we start here with Chapter 42, Tavern in the Town, which chronicles probably one of the lesser crimes of Robert Moses, but still makes a good story.
sentences.zh: 我们从第42章“城中酒馆”开始，这一章记录了罗伯特·摩西可能较小的罪行之一，但依然是一个好故事。

sentences.en: So how does it begin?
sentences.zh: 那么它是如何开始的呢？

sentences.en: It makes a great story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很棒的故事。

sentences.en: And it's also – I'll just say this before I even start, Roman.
sentences.zh: 而且——在开始之前我先说一句，罗曼。

sentences.en: This will be an annoying, unnecessary little tangent.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个令人讨厌且不必要的题外话。

sentences.en: 42, as anyone who's read The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy series knows, is the answer to the question of life, the universe, and everything.
sentences.zh: 42，正如任何读过《银河系漫游指南》系列的人所知，是关于生命、宇宙以及一切的终极答案。

sentences.en: And in this chapter, we get finally the answer to what will it take to really break away the reputation Moses has as the great guy, the parks man,
sentences.zh: 在这一章中，我们终于得到了答案：究竟需要什么才能真正打破摩西作为伟人、公园之父的声誉，

sentences.en: the man who can get things done for the people.
sentences.zh: 那个能为人民办实事的人。

sentences.en: It's in this chapter that what he does is seems so incredibly trivial and yet reverberates through so much.
sentences.zh: 在这一章里，他所做的事情看起来极其琐碎，却产生了巨大的反响。

sentences.en: So it begins talking about how this is going to be, the Battle of Central Park.
sentences.zh: 所以开头谈到了这将是“中央公园之战”。

sentences.en: Carol reminds everybody how in 1934, Robert Moses, he refurbished and renovated Central Park.
sentences.zh: 卡罗提醒大家，1934年罗伯特·摩西是如何翻新和改造中央公园的。

sentences.en: He replaced the Sheep Meadow, which previously had been full of inbred mutant sheep that had been there for generations.
sentences.zh: 他用一家餐厅——“绿茵酒馆”取代了羊草地，而那里之前世代居住着一群近亲繁殖的变异羊。

sentences.en: He replaces the Sheep Meadow near Central Park West and 67th Street with a restaurant, Tavern on the Green.
sentences.zh: 他用“绿茵酒馆”取代了中央公园西侧和67街附近的羊草地。

sentences.en: Regular listeners will know that's where my dad proposed to my mom before they got married.
sentences.zh: 经常收听的听众会知道，那是我父母结婚前向对方求婚的地方。

sentences.en: Ghostbusters fans will know it as the restaurant where Rick Moranis is finally overtaken by the terror dog.
sentences.zh: 《捉鬼敢死队》的影迷会知道，那是里克·莫拉尼斯最终被恐怖犬袭击的餐厅。

sentences.en: And I guess eaten, you know, in plain view of the diners at the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我想他被吃掉的时候，是在餐厅食客的众目睽睽之下。

sentences.en: And he cut a road extension into the park and a parking circle into the park that serves the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 他还在公园里开辟了一条道路延伸段，并为餐厅修建了一个停车环岛。

sentences.en: And what's funny to me here is that Carol is using the sheep as a symbol of the pastoral world that was shunted aside for the restaurant and its parking circle.
sentences.zh: 让我觉得有趣的是，卡罗在这里用羊作为田园世界的象征，而这个世界为了餐厅及其停车环岛而被排挤到了一边。

sentences.en: Back when Carol was talking about those sheep previously, they were monsters.
sentences.zh: 当卡罗之前谈到那些羊时，它们是怪物。

sentences.en: They were just like – they were implied as disgusting, something you needed to get rid of.
sentences.zh: 它们就像——被暗示为令人作呕的东西，是你需要摆脱的东西。

sentences.en: But now Carol is kind of having it both ways and he's like, what was once a bucolic sheep meadow?
sentences.zh: 但现在卡罗有点两头兼顾，他写道：曾经那片田园诗般的羊草地是什么样？

sentences.en: It's like, oh, all right.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，好吧。

sentences.en: There's different ways to look at sheep, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想看待羊的方式有很多种。

sentences.en: So the year is 1956.
sentences.zh: 现在是1956年。

sentences.en: Let's place ourselves in time.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到那个时代。

sentences.en: We are now in 1956.
sentences.zh: 我们现在身处1956年。

sentences.en: And local families have come to depend on this little tree-shaded glen between 67th and 68th streets in the park as a place for their kids to play.
sentences.zh: 当地家庭已经开始依赖公园里67街和68街之间这片绿树成荫的小峡谷，作为孩子们玩耍的地方。

sentences.en: They're using it the way parks have been intended by Moses to be used, as community spaces for people to play in them.
sentences.zh: 他们正在以摩西原本设想的方式使用公园，即作为人们玩耍的社区空间。

sentences.en: And the local mothers, they find the space especially precious.
sentences.zh: 当地的母亲们觉得这个空间尤为珍贵。

sentences.en: It's somewhere very close to their apartments.
sentences.zh: 它离她们的公寓非常近。

sentences.en: They're kids who live in apartments and have no outdoor space of their own.
sentences.zh: 她们的孩子住在公寓里，没有自己的户外空间。

sentences.en: And these are middle class, upper middle class kids.
sentences.zh: 这些是中产阶级、中上阶层的孩子。

sentences.en: These are kids who have resources.
sentences.zh: 这些孩子拥有资源。

sentences.en: These are not slum kids.
sentences.zh: 他们不是贫民窟的孩子。

sentences.en: But they still don't have outdoor space of their own.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍然没有自己的户外空间。

sentences.en: They don't have yards.
sentences.zh: 他们没有院子。

sentences.en: So this is a place they can run around.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个他们可以奔跑的地方。

sentences.en: The moms can talk.
sentences.zh: 妈妈们可以聊天。

sentences.en: It is a very important little place in their lives, a place that carries a lot of meaning and emotion for them.
sentences.zh: 这对她们的生活来说是一个非常重要的小地方，一个承载了她们许多意义和情感的地方。

sentences.en: Until one day on April 9th, 1956.
sentences.zh: 直到1956年4月9日的那一天。

sentences.en: What happens on that day, Roman?
sentences.zh: 那天发生了什么，罗曼？

sentences.en: Well, one of the moms, Roselle Davis, she sees these surveyors with blueprints looking over her bucolic glen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一位母亲罗泽尔·戴维斯，看到这些拿着蓝图的测量员正在查看她那片田园诗般的峡谷。

sentences.en: And when they break for lunch, they accidentally leave the blueprints behind.
sentences.zh: 当他们午休时，不小心把蓝图留在了那里。

sentences.en: And she reads on the title, detailed map of parking lot.
sentences.zh: 她在标题上读到：停车场详细地图。

sentences.en: And this is the plans to replace the glen with a parking lot to serve Tavern on the Green, which is just like a movie scene.
sentences.zh: 这就是用停车场取代峡谷以服务“绿茵酒馆”的计划，这简直就像电影场景一样。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Yeah, literally that it's like a parking lot here because they found these papers.
sentences.zh: 是的，字面意思上，就像因为发现了这些文件，这里就成了停车场。

sentences.en: And this is the kind of thing that if you saw it in a movie, you'd be like, come on.
sentences.zh: 这种事如果你在电影里看到，你会说，别逗了。

sentences.en: It happens in real life all the time.
sentences.zh: 但这在现实生活中一直都在发生。

sentences.en: I forget what Civil War battle it was where they literally found the Confederate plans wrapped around a cigar.
sentences.zh: 我不记得是哪场内战战役了，他们真的发现了包裹在雪茄上的南方军计划。

sentences.en: And they're like, oh, OK, now we know what's going to happen, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，哦，好吧，现在我们知道会发生什么了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And this is something that it's not necessarily important, but the last few chapters in the last episode felt very much like data, data, data.
sentences.zh: 这不一定很重要，但上一期节目的最后几章感觉非常像是数据、数据、数据。

sentences.en: Like I'm giving you hard information about this urban transportation issue.
sentences.zh: 就像我在给你提供关于城市交通问题的硬核信息。

sentences.en: And here it feels like Caro has shifted much more into reporter storyteller mode.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，感觉卡罗已经更多地转变为记者兼讲故事的人模式了。

sentences.en: He is telling a story.
sentences.zh: 他正在讲一个故事。

sentences.en: And this section is very dramatic, cinematic in a very fun way.
sentences.zh: 这一部分非常戏剧化，以一种非常有趣的方式具有电影感。

sentences.en: But that also sort of describes why this fight, unlike other fights that involve a lot of data or a lot of, you know,
sentences.zh: 但这也在某种程度上解释了为什么这场斗争，不像其他涉及大量数据或，你知道的，

sentences.en: a lot of like real problems that Moses has caused don't gain traction.
sentences.zh: 摩西造成的许多现实问题那样，无法获得关注。

sentences.en: Whereas this one with this nice story of these nice moms and their upper middle class life really does take hold in newspapers, which is really the big deal with this one.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，关于这些好妈妈和她们中上层生活的美好故事，确实在报纸上引起了轰动，这才是这次事件的重点。

sentences.en: Yes, it shows you the importance of a story, as we'll see, like the importance of a narrative, that it is hard to convince people with a lot of numbers,
sentences.zh: 是的，它向你展示了故事的重要性，正如我们将看到的，叙事的重要性，用大量数字去说服人们很难，

sentences.en: but it is much easier to convince people when you've got moms and kids versus bulldozers, as we'll see.
sentences.zh: 但当你面对的是妈妈和孩子对抗推土机时，说服人们就容易多了，正如我们将看到的。

sentences.en: And so Davis, she tells another mom, Augusta Newman, and Augusta Newman is the wife of Arnold Newman, who's a well-known photographer.
sentences.zh: 于是戴维斯告诉了另一位母亲奥古斯塔·纽曼，而奥古斯塔·纽曼是著名摄影师阿诺德·纽曼的妻子。

sentences.en: And I think this is one of the differences we had kind of talked about in previous episodes between what happens here and what happened earlier is these are people who have access to media.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们在之前节目中讨论过的，这里发生的事情与之前发生的事情之间的区别之一，那就是这些人能够接触到媒体。

sentences.en: These are people who have access to professional assistants or are professionals themselves in a way that the people of East Tremont,
sentences.zh: 这些人能够接触到专业助手，或者他们自己就是专业人士，这与东特雷蒙特的人民、

sentences.en: the people of Harlem just do not have access to.
sentences.zh: 哈莱姆区的人民根本无法接触到的资源不同。

sentences.en: And so they write up a petition and they try to get it signed by many of the well-known artists and writers who live on the block.
sentences.zh: 于是她们起草了一份请愿书，并试图让住在街区里的许多知名艺术家和作家签名。

sentences.en: Like a name that comes up a lot is the novelist Fanny Hurst, who I've not read any of her work, but I've heard the name before.
sentences.zh: 比如经常出现的一个名字是小说家范妮·赫斯特，我没读过她的作品，但我听过这个名字。

sentences.en: Caro mentions playwright and screenwriter Samson Rafelson, and he refers to him as Samuel Rafelson for some reason.
sentences.zh: 卡罗提到了剧作家兼编剧萨姆森·拉菲尔森，但他不知为何称他为塞缪尔·拉菲尔森。

sentences.en: But I don't – unless I'm getting the names mixed up, I don't know there is a Samuel Rafelson, but Samson Rafelson is a well-known – is a classic playwright, screenwriter.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道——除非我把名字搞混了，我不认为有塞缪尔·拉菲尔森这个人，但萨姆森·拉菲尔森是一位著名的——是一位经典的剧作家、编剧。

sentences.en: So this might be the third error I've ever found in the thousands of pages of Caro's work.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是我在卡罗数千页作品中发现的第三个错误。

sentences.en: And one of the other errors is just him getting the name of a movie slightly wrong in one of the Lyndon Johnson books.
sentences.zh: 而另一个错误只是他在其中一本林登·约翰逊的书里把电影名字写错了一点点。

sentences.en: So I'm not that mad about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我对此并不生气。

sentences.en: But this is like Ludwig Bemelman, the author of Madeline, lives here.
sentences.zh: 但这里住着路德维希·贝梅尔曼，《玛德琳》的作者。

sentences.en: Like Pearl Lang, the dancer.
sentences.zh: 还有舞者珀尔·朗。

sentences.en: Mae Murray, this former silenced movie star, lives there.
sentences.zh: 梅·默里，这位前默片明星也住在那儿。

sentences.en: And there are these other names that I'm sure were more well-known when the book came out but would have to be researched by modern readers.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些名字，我相信在书出版时更为人所知，但现代读者可能需要去研究一下。

sentences.en: But in the end, they have this petition with just 23 names on it.
sentences.zh: 但最终，她们的请愿书上只有23个名字。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen petitions with thousands of names get knocked aside.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们见过成千上万个名字的请愿书被驳回。

sentences.en: And the Park Department, they're like, yeah, 23-name petition?
sentences.zh: 而公园管理部门的态度是，是的，一份23人的请愿书？

sentences.en: I'm ignoring this.
sentences.zh: 我无视它。

sentences.en: We don't want to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 我们不想处理这个。

sentences.en: And the newly installed deputy mayor tries to arrange a meeting and is told off by one of Moses' secretaries over the phone.
sentences.zh: 新上任的副市长试图安排一次会面，却在电话里被摩西的一位秘书训斥了一顿。

sentences.en: But here's the difference.
sentences.zh: 但区别就在这里。

sentences.en: One of the moms, she signs it.
sentences.zh: 其中一位母亲签了名。

sentences.en: She is not just a person with access to the newspapers.
sentences.zh: 她不仅仅是一个能接触到报纸的人。

sentences.en: She is a person who is married to a Herald Tribune reporter.
sentences.zh: 她还是《先驱论坛报》记者的妻子。

sentences.en: So Roman, this time, is personal.
