sentences.en: Dungeons & Dragons is a storytelling game where one person is the dungeon master who writes an adventure.
sentences.zh: 《龙与地下城》是一款讲故事的游戏，其中一个人担任地下城主，负责编写冒险剧本。

sentences.en: And their friends are the players, and they each have one character.
sentences.zh: 而他们的朋友则是玩家，每个人扮演一个角色。

sentences.en: So basically you have a group of heroes.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上你有一群英雄。

sentences.en: Every hero is being played by one person at the table.
sentences.zh: 每个英雄都由桌边的一位玩家扮演。

sentences.en: And their job is just to go on the adventure role-playing as their hero.
sentences.zh: 他们的任务就是以英雄的身份去进行冒险。

sentences.en: And the dungeon master's job is to be everything and everyone else.
sentences.zh: 而地下城主的任务是扮演其他所有人和所有事物。

sentences.en: All the monsters, all the allies, all the environs.
sentences.zh: 所有的怪物、所有的盟友、所有的环境。

sentences.en: And basically you're just going on an adventure.
sentences.zh: 基本上你们就是在进行一场冒险。

sentences.en: It's a group storytelling.
sentences.zh: 这是一种集体叙事。

sentences.en: You're collaboratively writing this adventure improvisationally in the moment.
sentences.zh: 你们在即兴创作中共同编写这段冒险。

sentences.en: And the game aspect comes in in moments of stress, risk, and uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 而游戏的博弈感体现在压力、风险和不确定性的时刻。

sentences.en: So you go into combat.
sentences.zh: 比如你们进入战斗。

sentences.en: Do you slay the dragon or does the dragon devour you?
sentences.zh: 你是屠龙，还是被龙吞噬？

sentences.en: We're going to roll dice to find out.
sentences.zh: 我们要掷骰子来决定。

sentences.en: Do you crack the code in the massive spell book or do you raise your fist to the sky and shake and say, no, I cannot decipher the codex?
sentences.zh: 你是破解了那本巨大的法术书，还是举起拳头向天空挥舞，说：“不，我无法解读这本法典”？

sentences.en: That's a dice roll, right?
sentences.zh: 那得掷骰子，对吧？

sentences.en: So all these moments of dramatic peak are determined by rolls of the dice, which creates this really wonderful feeling, whether you watch D&D shows or you play D&D,
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些戏剧性的巅峰时刻都是由掷骰子决定的，这创造了一种非常美妙的感觉，无论你是看龙与地下城节目还是亲自玩，

sentences.en: where you are watching a story being told by people who love telling that story.
sentences.zh: 你都在观看一群热爱讲故事的人讲述一个故事。

sentences.en: And the intoxicating part is not only do you not know where this is going to go, the people telling the story are discovering alongside you where the story is going to go.
sentences.zh: 最令人着迷的部分不仅在于你不知道故事会走向何方，甚至连讲故事的人也在和你一起探索故事的走向。

sentences.en: So we have a Discord server where we talk about the book and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个Discord服务器，我们在那里讨论书之类的内容。

sentences.en: And you came up very, very early in discussions of like, who should we have as potential guests?
sentences.zh: 在讨论潜在嘉宾人选时，你很早就被提到了。

sentences.en: Because a lot of people listen to us, enjoy your show.
sentences.zh: 因为很多人听我们的节目，也很喜欢你的节目。

sentences.en: And the idea of Robert Moses, the Robert Moses in this book, morphing into a fantasy villain.
sentences.zh: 而且罗伯特·摩西，也就是书中那个罗伯特·摩西，变身为奇幻反派的想法，

sentences.en: And he is morphed quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 他确实发生了很大的变化。

sentences.en: We should explain a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 我们应该解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: Is kind of genius.
sentences.zh: 简直是天才之举。

sentences.en: And it's just sort of fun to sort of bring the real world into this fantasy world and play with that.
sentences.zh: 把现实世界带入这个奇幻世界并进行演绎，这本身就很有趣。

sentences.en: So let's first talk about who Robert Moses in Unsleeping City is.
sentences.zh: 那么我们先来谈谈《不眠之城》里的罗伯特·摩西是谁。

sentences.en: Let's describe him a little bit because he's a little bit changed.
sentences.zh: 我们来描述一下他，因为他稍微有点改变。

sentences.en: He's yeah,
sentences.zh: 他是，没错，

sentences.en: I would say that he is a very fantasy villain version of the historical figure and one very much sort of taken up with presumably the decades of whatever his public historical life was.
sentences.zh: 我会说他是一个非常奇幻反派版本的历史人物，而且很大程度上承袭了他那几十年的公共历史生活。

sentences.en: We're now in the year 2019, you know, after decades of magical shenanigans going on in the fantasy universe.
sentences.zh: 我们现在处于2019年，你知道，在奇幻宇宙中经历了数十年的魔法闹剧之后。

sentences.en: I should also mention that in terms of license with real figures, we did have Stephen Sondheim as an ally of the of the player characters who wielded two broadswords,
sentences.zh: 我还应该提到，就对真实人物的艺术加工而言，我们确实让斯蒂芬·桑德海姆成为了玩家角色的盟友，他挥舞着两把阔剑，

sentences.en: one in each hand.
sentences.zh: 一手一把。

sentences.en: So there is a little bit of creative license with some of our beloved New York.
sentences.zh: 所以对于我们心爱的纽约，确实有一点艺术加工。

sentences.en: He was usually a one weapon fighter.
sentences.zh: 他通常是个单武器战士。

sentences.en: Stephen Sondheim.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·桑德海姆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In real life, he was a he was a sort of saber or rapier.
sentences.zh: 在现实生活中，他是个用军刀或细剑的人。

sentences.en: You know, he was a one hand fencer.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是个单手剑客。

sentences.en: But we thought it would be fine.
sentences.zh: 但我们觉得这样也没问题。

sentences.en: It's a little license.
sentences.zh: 稍微加工一下。

sentences.en: So we gave him two claymores.
sentences.zh: 所以我们给了他两把苏格兰阔剑。

sentences.en: Robert Moses, as he's depicted in The Unsleeping City, is the architect of a thing called the Highway Hex.
sentences.zh: 《不眠之城》中描绘的罗伯特·摩西是“公路咒”的建筑师。

sentences.en: And the Highway Hex is if you guys are familiar at all with the concept of ley lines, which are basically magical directional veins that can intersect and create nodes of power.
sentences.zh: 如果你熟悉“地脉”的概念，即那些可以交叉并形成能量节点的魔法方向脉络，那么公路咒就是基于此。

sentences.en: And it's sort of based on some real world belief systeMs.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上基于一些现实世界的信仰体系。

sentences.en: And the idea behind Robert Moses and the Unsleeping City is that the Highway Hex was him creating a complex arcane rune,
sentences.zh: 《不眠之城》中罗伯特·摩西背后的构思是，公路咒是他创造的一个复杂的奥术符文，

sentences.en: a glyph of the intersecting highways and expressways within New York City to repel divination from the forces of good.
sentences.zh: 一个由纽约市纵横交错的高速公路和快速路组成的字形，用来抵御正义力量的占卜。

sentences.en: So he's a basically remains a master builder,
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上仍然是一位建筑大师，

sentences.en: remains someone whose ideology is very rooted in the concrete and building and the creation of an infrastructure with this added level of arcane magical threat on top of it,
sentences.zh: 仍然是一个意识形态深深植根于混凝土、建筑和基础设施建设的人，只不过叠加了一层奥术魔法威胁，

sentences.en: that all of the traffic in New York is actually casting this elaborate fiendish spell.
sentences.zh: 纽约所有的交通实际上都在施展这个精心设计的邪恶咒语。

sentences.en: So this version of Robert Moses, when Robert Carroll is interviewing him, would point out to Fire Island and say, don't you see there should be a glyph there?
sentences.zh: 所以这个版本的罗伯特·摩西，当罗伯特·卡罗采访他时，会指着火岛说，难道你不觉得那里应该有一个字形吗？

sentences.en: Shouldn't there be a glyph out there?
sentences.zh: 那里不应该有一个字形吗？

sentences.en: Like that it's – but it's still – like you're saying, it's still rooted in the things we know about Robert Moses, about his predilection for slashing roads across everything.
sentences.zh: 就像——但这仍然——就像你说的，它仍然植根于我们所知的罗伯特·摩西，关于他那种在一切事物上强行开路的偏好。

sentences.en: But you're giving him, if anything, kind of a more rational reason.
sentences.zh: 但你给了他一个更合理的理由。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We're explaining in retrospect why he was so obsessed with building all these expressways.
sentences.zh: 我们是在事后解释他为什么如此痴迷于修建所有这些快速路。

sentences.en: And like I get why his road has to take a sudden curve in through East Tremont if it's because, oh, well, we're drawing some sort of sigil or some sort of occult sign.
sentences.zh: 比如我明白为什么他的路必须在东特雷蒙特突然转弯，如果是因为，哦，好吧，我们正在绘制某种符印或某种神秘符号。

sentences.en: And it has to be exactly the right way.
sentences.zh: 而且它必须以完全正确的方式呈现。

sentences.en: It makes more sense than his – than any of the reasons that we got otherwise.
sentences.zh: 这比我们得到的任何其他理由都更有意义。

sentences.en: I'm very curious about your – so you've read The Power Broker, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我对你的——我相信你读过《权力掮客》。

sentences.en: This is not – you're not just existing off of the urban legends of Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是——你不仅仅是靠罗伯特·摩西的都市传说来创作的。

sentences.en: What is it – it strikes me as such an interesting book to use as a foundation text for a fantasy story because it is such – it is so grounded in, in many ways,
sentences.zh: 它给我的感觉是一本非常有趣的书，可以作为奇幻故事的基础文本，因为它在很多方面都非常扎实，

sentences.en: the real kind of like minutiae and data of urban construction, traffic flow, things like that.
sentences.zh: 有着真实的城市建设、交通流量等方面的细节和数据。

sentences.en: Is it – what is it about it that planted this into your mind that like, yeah, I could use this for a D&D campaign?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你觉得，是的，我可以把它用于龙与地下城战役？

sentences.en: You know, it's a great question and there's a lot – I mean like especially growing up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很好的问题，而且有很多——我是说，特别是在成长过程中。

sentences.en: So I have an odd biography, right?
sentences.zh: 我的经历很奇怪，对吧？

sentences.en: I went to school a little bit early.
sentences.zh: 我上学比较早。

sentences.en: I had started attending college at SUNY Ulster when I was 14 for philosophy and humanities and was used to – I remember, you know, as a teenager reading Howard Zinn,
sentences.zh: 我14岁时就开始在纽约州立大学阿尔斯特分校学习哲学和人文科学，习惯了——我记得，你知道，作为一个青少年，我读过霍华德·津恩的书，

sentences.en: which is a very similar book in terms of like, oh my god,
sentences.zh: 那本书在某种程度上非常相似，就像，天哪，

sentences.en: this is 80 pages on like – and these many bushels of barley were being exported and were tabulating kind of the economies of this portion of time.
sentences.zh: 这有80页都在讲——这些大麦被出口了，并统计了这一时期的经济状况。

sentences.en: And then it will move to a page where you'll read a chapter that makes you burst into tears, right?
sentences.zh: 然后你会翻到一页，读到一个让你泪流满面的章节，对吧？

sentences.en: Where the human cost of all of this data is rendered very plainly.
sentences.zh: 所有这些数据背后的人类代价被非常直白地呈现出来。

sentences.en: And to be honest with you, a lot of the Unsleeping City that first season was rooted in – and very much dedicated to and sort of honoring my father.
sentences.zh: 老实说，《不眠之城》第一季的很多内容都植根于——并且在很大程度上致力于并以某种方式纪念我的父亲。

sentences.en: So I'm a New Yorker.
sentences.zh: 我是一个纽约人。

sentences.en: My father has lived in New York my entire life and we would walk around – during my childhood and he had this incredible – his name is Joe Mulligan.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在我的一生中都住在纽约，我们经常四处走动——在我童年时期，他有着令人难以置信的——他叫乔·穆里根。

sentences.en: He had this encyclopedic knowledge of New York history.
sentences.zh: 他拥有百科全书般的纽约历史知识。

sentences.en: And anywhere we would be going to museums or going up to the cloisters or going downtown, he took me to Five Points when I was a little kid.
sentences.zh: 无论我们去博物馆，还是去修道院博物馆，或者去市中心，我小时候他就带我去过五点区。

sentences.en: He had – before Gangs of New York came out and, you know, we laugh about it now because he would point somewhere and be like, and this is where Bill Poole, you know,
sentences.zh: 在《纽约黑帮》上映之前，他就——你知道，我们现在回想起来觉得很好笑，因为他会指着某个地方说，这就是比尔·普尔，你知道，

sentences.en: or this is where William – you know, like came out and this is what happened.
sentences.zh: 或者这就是威廉——你知道，他会说这里发生了什么。

sentences.en: And he'd be pointing at a Dunkin' Donuts, right?
sentences.zh: 他指着一家甜甜圈店，对吧？

sentences.en: Like this is the site of ultimate significance.
sentences.zh: 就像这是具有重大意义的地点。

sentences.en: And he – prior even to reading anything about Moses, you're right.
sentences.zh: 而且他——甚至在读任何关于摩西的书之前，你是对的。

sentences.en: Like urban legend is a good way to put it.
sentences.zh: 都市传说是形容它的好方法。

sentences.en: But my father as a New Yorker spoke about Robert Moses with this idea of like this is someone who forever altered the city and, you know, explaining the heights of bridges and,
sentences.zh: 但我父亲作为一个纽约人，谈论罗伯特·摩西时，认为他是一个永远改变了这座城市的人，你知道，解释桥梁的高度，以及，

sentences.en: you know, the discrimination of keeping various groups out from these – you know, that these people will have luxury and plenty and these people will not.
sentences.zh: 你知道，通过歧视将各种群体拒之门外——你知道，这些人会拥有奢华和富足，而那些人则不会。

sentences.en: And in terms of like – and in terms of like what drew me to this document and this extremely kind of like – if we're being honest, the crimes,
sentences.zh: 至于——至于是什么吸引我使用这份文件，以及这种极其——说实话，这家伙的罪行，

sentences.en: the social ills of this guy are so fascinating in that the greatest harm is done through these things that require a kind of pointed attention to understand what's happening,
sentences.zh: 他的社会弊病非常迷人，因为最大的伤害是通过那些需要敏锐的注意力才能理解发生了什么的事情造成的，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like these – you know, like it's not salacious.
sentences.zh: 就像这些——你知道，它并不耸人听闻。

sentences.en: It's not this thing where it's like the big harms are done by manipulating authorities and manipulating money and manipulating power.
sentences.zh: 它不是那种通过操纵权威、操纵金钱和操纵权力来造成巨大伤害的事情。

sentences.en: And I think it was looking at a setting set in a magical New York and specifically dealing with the idea of how do you fight somebody who's not even interacting with you?
sentences.zh: 我认为这是在观察一个设定在魔法纽约的背景，特别是处理如何对抗一个甚至不与你互动的人的问题？

sentences.en: They are in control of the environment and your conception of freedom,
sentences.zh: 他们控制着环境，而你对自由的构想，

sentences.en: your conception of what individual action can be is totally put up against this guy like you're saying from source material that is very, very like rooted in infrastructure,
sentences.zh: 你对个人行动可以是什么的构想，完全被这个家伙所压制，就像你说的，源自于非常非常植根于基础设施、

sentences.en: administration, bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: 行政、官僚主义的素材。

sentences.en: So, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，

sentences.en: you want to have this big fantasy showdown and it felt like the right way to do that was with a guy with this massive history of extremely dense action that was taken at this level that most individuals don't know how to oppose.
sentences.zh: 你想进行一场盛大的奇幻对决，而感觉实现这一点的正确方式，就是通过一个有着极其密集行动历史的家伙，这些行动是在大多数人不知道如何反对的层面上采取的。

sentences.en: Trevor Burrus It's something that ties into the episode we were talking about today.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗·伯勒斯：这与我们今天讨论的剧集有关。

sentences.en: We talked about how the reporters who were trying to make it clear what Moses was doing were having trouble communicating it to the public because it was so complicated and it was not salacious.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到那些试图弄清楚摩西在做什么的记者，在向公众传达时遇到了困难，因为它太复杂了，而且并不耸人听闻。

sentences.en: And what they finally got traction with was, well, they hired an ex-mob guy as a night watchman, so the mob's involved.
sentences.zh: 他们最终取得进展的方法是，他们雇佣了一个前黑帮成员做夜班保安，所以黑帮卷入了进来。

sentences.en: And it seems like it would be a big challenge in creating that kind of traditional fantasy adventure climax when you are dealing with somebody who himself is not a conniving villain so much as the – I guess he is pretty conniving.
sentences.zh: 在创造那种传统的奇幻冒险高潮时，当你面对一个本身不是那种诡计多端的反派，或者说——我想他确实挺诡计多端的。

sentences.en: But who's not so much a cackling evil villain so much as – I guess he kind of does that too.
sentences.zh: 但他不是那种只会狂笑的邪恶反派，而是——我想他也有点那样。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Never mind.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Never mind.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: It makes more sense than I thought.
sentences.zh: 它比我想象的更有意义。

sentences.en: Trevor Burrus I'll say there's a lot of meat on the bone.
sentences.zh: 特雷弗·伯勒斯：我会说这很有料。

sentences.en: You know, he really did give us a lot to work with for sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他确实给了我们很多可以发挥的东西，这是肯定的。

sentences.en: I mean, I was actually thinking of rather than the incongruities of the text and then your storytelling built on top of it is some of the congruities,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我实际上想的不是文本的不协调之处，而是你在此基础上构建的故事中的一些协调之处，

sentences.en: which is like the idea of Robert Moses being able to write these laws over the course of the first couple of decades of his life that give him power for the remaining decades almost seems like a wizard.
sentences.zh: 比如罗伯特·摩西能够在他人生的最初几十年里写下这些法律，从而为他剩下的几十年提供权力，这看起来几乎像个巫师。

sentences.en: It almost seems like a magic spell that he has done to create and accumulate and build and build and build the same way that you level up and build in D&D.
sentences.zh: 这看起来几乎像是一个魔法咒语，他通过创造、积累、建设，再建设，就像你在龙与地下城中升级和建设一样。

sentences.en: Like it has that quality of a wizard in a way.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上确实具有巫师的特质。

sentences.en: You could look at the power broker as kind of a real-world version of all the things that happened with Sauron before the Lord of the Rings,
sentences.zh: 你可以把《权力掮客》看作是索伦在《指环王》之前发生的所有事情的现实版本，

sentences.en: all the things that happened in the past where he amasses this power because of secret knowledge and because of the artifacts of that power.
sentences.zh: 所有过去发生的事情，他因为秘密知识和权力的神器而积累了这种力量。

sentences.en: And then has this period of dominance and then has his downfall more because of his own overreaching than because of anything else.
sentences.zh: 然后经历了一段统治时期，最后因为自己的过度扩张而垮台，而不是因为其他任何原因。

sentences.en: I mean, you have to assume that Sauron would not talk himself into resigning because he's worried Nelson Rockefeller is going to make him look foolish at a press conference.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你必须假设索伦不会因为担心纳尔逊·洛克菲勒会在新闻发布会上让他看起来很愚蠢，就说服自己辞职。

sentences.en: But you don't know.
sentences.zh: 但你不知道。

sentences.en: It could have happened that way too.
sentences.zh: 它也可能就是那样发生的。

sentences.en: It could have happened that way.
sentences.zh: 它可能就是那样发生的。

sentences.en: As the wizard Gandalf, I call a press conference.
sentences.zh: 作为巫师甘道夫，我召开新闻发布会。

sentences.en: The Dark Lord.
sentences.zh: 黑魔王。

sentences.en: I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a part of depicting Moses in this, in The Unsleeping City, which was showing, especially because of who our heroes were.
sentences.zh: 我认为在《不眠之城》中描绘摩西的一部分，是为了展示，特别是考虑到我们的英雄是谁。

sentences.en: So, like, the heroes of our party are people – you know, Lou Wilson's character, Kingston Brown,
sentences.zh: 所以，我们队伍的英雄是——你知道，卢·威尔逊的角色，金斯顿·布朗，

sentences.en: is a nurse in Harlem who is a fixture of his community and knows everybody in the city and is tapped into those communities and working people.
sentences.zh: 是哈莱姆区的一名护士，他是社区的中流砥柱，认识城里的每一个人，并与那些社区和劳动人民保持着联系。

sentences.en: We have Ali Beardsley's character is Pete Conlon who's, like, a dream sorcerer who's, like, a part-time drug dealer in the art scene in Bushwick.
sentences.zh: 我们还有阿里·比尔兹利的角色，皮特·康伦，他是一个梦境巫师，也是布什威克艺术圈里的兼职毒贩。

sentences.en: So, you have these, like, sort of New Yorker staples that are all from different walks of life.
sentences.zh: 所以，你有这些来自不同生活背景的纽约人代表。

sentences.en: And the idea of – you're making this point with this group of characters that become our heroes in this story that are all magical New Yorkers of the power of not only community but the power of diverse community,
sentences.zh: 而这个想法——你通过这群成为我们故事英雄的角色表达了一个观点，他们都是魔法纽约人，不仅拥有社区的力量，还拥有多元社区的力量，

sentences.en: the power of – you know, what's the word I'm looking for?
sentences.zh: 拥有——你知道，我想要表达的那个词是什么？

sentences.en: I'm looking for multiculturalism or, like, that idea of a big pluralistic society, right?
sentences.zh: 我想要说的是多元文化主义，或者说，那种宏大的多元化社会的理念，对吧？

sentences.en: And the idea of there being – and there definitely are forces at work against that and there are definitely depictions in the season and elsewhere of that kind of know-nothing nativist where it's meeting a cultural force with an opposing cultural force and saying,
sentences.zh: 而且这种想法——确实有力量在反对这一点，而且在这一季和其他地方确实有对那种“无知本土主义者”的描绘，即用一种文化力量去对抗另一种文化力量，并说，

sentences.en: like, okay, you want a pluralistic multicultural society.
sentences.zh: 就像，好吧，你想要一个多元化的多元文化社会。

sentences.en: We don't.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要。

sentences.en: We want, you know, homogenous and this one type, this sort of nativist ideal.
sentences.zh: 我们想要，你知道，同质化的，这种单一类型的，这种本土主义的理想。

sentences.en: But that's one way to oppose that.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种反对它的方式。

sentences.en: The other way to oppose that is to sidestep culture in totality and go, hey, you can believe what you want.
sentences.zh: 反对那种做法的另一种方式是完全避开文化，然后说，嘿，你想信什么就信什么。

sentences.en: I'll shape the city without any worry about what – you know, in these chapters that you guys are talking about, like,
sentences.zh: 我会塑造这座城市，而不必担心什么——你知道，在你们谈论的这些章节里，比如，

sentences.en: the funny thing is how long protests had been trivial to him where it's like if you know how to get around this, if you know how to actually move power around,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，抗议活动对他来说长期以来是多么微不足道，就像如果你知道如何绕过这个，如果你知道如何真正地转移权力，

sentences.en: if people are paying your tolls, if people are giving you this power and energy outside of their belief system just because they're driving on your road,
sentences.zh: 如果人们在支付你的过路费，如果人们在他们的信仰体系之外给你这种权力和能量，仅仅因为他们在你的道路上行驶，

sentences.en: how much of their buy-in do you really need on that cultural level, right?
sentences.zh: 那么在文化层面上，你到底需要他们多少认同，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's so sinister to me, that idea of manipulating – like you're saying, it's a wizardly thing.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说太阴险了，那种操纵的想法——就像你说的，这是一种巫术。

sentences.en: It's manipulating a system of power where you're like, I don't need to interface with you.
sentences.zh: 这是一种操纵权力体系的方式，你会觉得，我不需要与你互动。

sentences.en: I don't need to be in conversation with you.
sentences.zh: 我不需要与你对话。

sentences.en: I have mastered a secret language, whether that's law or finance or in this case, you know, the bonds being issued to the authority.
sentences.zh: 我已经掌握了一种秘密语言，无论是法律、金融，还是在这种情况下，你知道，发给当局的债券。

sentences.en: Like, you memorize this, again, like lingua arcana and all of a sudden it doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 就像，你记住了这个，再说一次，就像神秘语言一样，突然之间，这就不重要了。

sentences.en: You have sidestepped that entire frame of reference up to a point, of course.
sentences.zh: 你已经避开了整个参考框架，当然，在一定程度上是这样。

sentences.en: But that's what's so interesting about that metaphor to me of the city authority as wizard, as someone whose power does not reflect interaction with, you know,
sentences.zh: 但这就是那个关于城市当局作为巫师的隐喻对我来说如此有趣的地方，作为一个人，他的权力并不反映与，你知道，

sentences.en: large groups of people,
sentences.zh: 大群人的互动，

sentences.en: but rather with systems that people are supporting unbeknownst to them.
sentences.zh: 而是与人们在不知不觉中支持的系统互动。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: So the story is that to gain his power, he sort of sells his soul to different factions, to hell and to the fairy.
sentences.zh: 所以故事是这样的，为了获得权力，他把自己的灵魂卖给了不同的派系，卖给了地狱和仙界。

sentences.en: And then he builds the highway hex as a way to kind of insulate him because then at that point they're all coming after him and he's trying to like keep them out.
sentences.zh: 然后他建造了高速公路结界，作为一种隔离自己的方式，因为在那一点上，他们都在追捕他，而他试图把他们挡在外面。

sentences.en: And that sort of action of being surrounded by highways just disrupts their ability to sort of go get him.
sentences.zh: 那种被高速公路包围的行为，破坏了他们去抓他的能力。

sentences.en: And so he's basically remaking the city in this selfish way just to protect, like he'll put the misery on everyone else to like circle this city and circle this city forever,
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是以这种自私的方式重塑城市，只是为了保护自己，就像他会把痛苦强加给其他人，让城市永远被包围，

sentences.en: just so he can't be gotten at by demons who are, I guess, worse than him in some way.
sentences.zh: 只是为了不被那些我猜在某种程度上比他更糟糕的恶魔抓到。

sentences.en: Which is, again, it's like it's a nice way to embody this, like put a story on this, this very sinister thing to remake something without any sort of input from anyone else,
sentences.zh: 这又一次，这是一种很好的方式来体现这一点，给这个非常阴险的事情加上一个故事，在没有任何其他人输入的情况下重塑某物，

sentences.en: just destroy a place just to make yourself safe is diabolical.
sentences.zh: 仅仅为了让自己安全而摧毁一个地方是极其邪恶的。

sentences.en: And the fact that everyone knows in the setting, they're like, oh, yeah, like big celestial or fey or infernal forces can't come to the city.
sentences.zh: 而且每个人都知道这个设定，他们会说，哦，是的，像伟大的天界、仙界或冥界的势力无法来到这座城市。

sentences.en: Like everyone knows the ramifications, but it's a discovery in the midst of the season that that is because of this highway hex and it's to protect one individual.
sentences.zh: 就像每个人都知道后果，但在这一季中发现，这是因为这个高速公路结界，而且是为了保护一个人。

sentences.en: And you go like, so you're saying the entire shape of my cosmology, like how I understand the magical world to work is not some massive, it's not like that's been here.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得，所以你是说我整个宇宙观的形状，就像我理解魔法世界运作的方式，不是什么巨大的东西，不是那种一直都在这里的东西。

sentences.en: Like maybe that's why they built the city here.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是他们把城市建在这里的原因。

sentences.en: No, it's one guy's actions that reshaped everything.
sentences.zh: 不，是一个人的行为重塑了一切。

sentences.en: And I think the moment, obviously, again, we have a very fantastical villain in our Robert Moses, who, you know, he's way over the top.
sentences.zh: 我认为那一刻，显然，再一次，我们的罗伯特·摩西是一个非常奇幻的恶棍，你知道，他太夸张了。

sentences.en: But as far as villain goes, does attempt a lot of like persuasion and flattery, really tries to get Allie Beardsley's character, tries to, you know,
sentences.zh: 但就恶棍而言，确实尝试了很多说服和奉承，真的试图让艾莉·比尔兹利的角色，试图，你知道，

sentences.en: make Pete Conlon into a Moses man.
sentences.zh: 把皮特·康伦变成摩西的人。

sentences.en: You got fucked, kid.
sentences.zh: 你被搞砸了，孩子。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, did you sign up for this Vox Phantasma job?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你报名参加这个幻影之声的工作了吗？

sentences.en: Did you weigh the health benefits?
sentences.zh: 你权衡过健康福利吗？

sentences.en: Did you get a choice in the matter?
sentences.zh: 你在这件事上有选择权吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Does it suck to be the Vox Phantasma?
sentences.zh: 做幻影之声很糟糕吗？

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢？

sentences.en: You're homeless.
sentences.zh: 你无家可归。

sentences.en: You got a bunch of probleMs.
sentences.zh: 你有一堆问题。

sentences.en: That's just New York.
sentences.zh: 这就是纽约。

sentences.en: I think there's one confrontation towards the end of the season where I was like,
sentences.zh: 我想在这一季快结束时有一场对抗，当时我就想，

sentences.en: if there's anything that feels like a statement towards the historical Moses that feels really pointed,
sentences.zh: 如果有什么感觉像是对历史上的摩西的声明，感觉非常尖锐，

sentences.en: there's a confrontation between him and Kingston Brown at the Temple of Dender at the Met.
sentences.zh: 那就是他和金斯顿·布朗在大都会博物馆丹德神庙之间的对抗。

sentences.en: I hate to say it, Mr. Moses, but they're all free-thinking adults who can make their own choices.
sentences.zh: 我不想这么说，摩西先生，但他们都是可以做出自己选择的自由思考的成年人。

sentences.en: As is every person in this city.
sentences.zh: 这座城市里的每个人也是如此。

sentences.en: See, he says, you think people make choices?
sentences.zh: 你看，他说，你以为人们会做出选择？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: People think they make choices.
sentences.zh: 人们以为他们做出了选择。

sentences.en: They think they're going to steer right or steer left.
sentences.zh: 他们以为他们要向右转或向左转。

sentences.en: But they didn't build the roads.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有建造道路。

sentences.en: The big choices already got made for them a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 重大的选择很久以前就已经为他们做好了。

sentences.en: And that, to me, is like the heart of his sinister philosophy in the Unsleeping City.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就是他在《不眠之城》中阴险哲学的核心。

sentences.en: And the thing that as someone who, you know, I come to this as a philosophy major, as someone who studied philosophy, you know, the impact that he had on this country,
sentences.zh: 作为一个哲学专业，作为一个研究过哲学的人，你知道，他给这个国家带来的影响，

sentences.en: forget just New York, but the country broadly, is so profound.
sentences.zh: 别说只是纽约，而是整个国家，是如此深远。

sentences.en: And America, I think, has a cultural love for the idea of individual freedom and the idea that, like, freedom is a substance that lives in the individual.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国在文化上热爱个人自由的理念，以及自由是一种存在于个人之中的物质的理念。

sentences.en: And your ability to be a heroic cowboy figure who does whatever the hell, like, no one's going to tell me what to do.
sentences.zh: 以及你成为一个英雄牛仔的能力，做任何该死的事情，就像，没有人会告诉我该怎么做。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's very rooted in the American thing.
sentences.zh: 这非常扎根于美国的东西。

sentences.en: The rug is totally pulled out from under that philosophy if you have to reckon with the fact that life is multiple choice, that you are not born on a blank page.
sentences.zh: 如果你必须面对生活是多项选择，你不是出生在一张白纸上的事实，那么这种哲学的基础就完全被抽走了。

sentences.en: You were born into the context that has often been shaped by very powerful people.
sentences.zh: 你出生在一个通常由非常有权势的人塑造的环境中。

sentences.en: I want to point out for anyone who's listening who is not a New Yorker, when you mention the Temple of Dender,
sentences.zh: 我想为任何不是纽约人的听众指出，当你提到丹德神庙时，

sentences.en: I want people to know that that's a real Egyptian temple that's in the Metropolitan Museum, not a fantasy, like, magic temple.
sentences.zh: 我想让人们知道那是一个在大都会博物馆里的真实埃及神庙，而不是一个幻想的魔法神庙。

sentences.en: They're going to, and it makes me think about how there are viewers of the show who did not know that Robert Moses was a real person when they started watching it.
sentences.zh: 他们会，这让我想到，节目中有些观众在开始观看时并不知道罗伯特·摩西是一个真实的人。

sentences.en: And did that, is that a surprise to you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是个惊喜吗？

sentences.en: That there, you see, like, on Reddit, people are like, just found out Robert Moses is real.
sentences.zh: 你在Reddit上看到人们说，刚发现罗伯特·摩西是真实的。

sentences.en: I thought he was just a character in the story.
sentences.zh: 我以为他只是故事里的一个角色。

sentences.en: Does that, does that make you feel like you have more of a responsibility to present it to you or you should have presented more authentically than as a, as a magical monster man?
sentences.zh: 这是否让你觉得你有更多的责任去呈现他，或者你应该呈现得比一个魔法怪物更真实？

sentences.en: You know, like me and the guy who puts the facts on the Snapple caps, we get together, we get together and kind of commiserate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我和那个在Snapple瓶盖上写事实的人，我们聚在一起，互相诉苦。

sentences.en: The responsibility of it, with that, it comes with that power, yeah.
sentences.zh: 责任感，伴随着那种权力，是的。

sentences.en: It comes with that power.
sentences.zh: 它伴随着那种权力。

sentences.en: Yes, I think that there's a, there's a very pointed feeling of, anytime you're doing anything connected to, like, historicity or historical, you know,
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为有一种非常尖锐的感觉，任何时候你做任何与历史性或历史相关的事情，你知道，

sentences.en: I think a lot of the players in that season who had not lived in New York also felt like, oh, how do I honor this very real place?
sentences.zh: 我认为那一季中许多没有住在纽约的玩家也觉得，哦，我该如何尊重这个非常真实的地方？

sentences.en: And we had, you know, Stephen Sondheim is mentioned there.
sentences.zh: 我们有，你知道，斯蒂芬·桑德海姆在那里被提及。

sentences.en: We mentioned in the second season, there's, like, a fight at Ellis Island where people are, like, jumping into photographs from Ellis Island of, like,
sentences.zh: 我们在第二季提到过，有一个在埃利斯岛的战斗，人们就像，跳进埃利斯岛的照片里，关于，比如，

sentences.en: different waves of immigration in the city.
sentences.zh: 城市中不同移民浪潮。

sentences.en: You're trying to, like, honor these things, not only in a fantasy show, but in an improvised fantasy show where, you know, it's like, well,
sentences.zh: 你试图尊重这些事情，不仅是在一部奇幻剧中，而且是在一部即兴奇幻剧中，你知道，就像，好吧，

sentences.en: our first priority is to make sure that our story reflects our values and is compelling and interesting and funny.
sentences.zh: 我们的首要任务是确保我们的故事反映我们的价值观，并且引人入胜、有趣且好笑。

sentences.en: And I think, like, people finding out that Robert Moses is real through this, I can only hope that it shuttles them on to the power broker and to reading the history.
sentences.zh: 我认为，人们通过这个发现罗伯特·摩西是真实的，我只能希望这能引导他们去读《权力掮客》和历史。

sentences.en: Please don't take the headline from an improvised D&D show.
sentences.zh: 请不要从一个即兴的龙与地下城节目中获取头条新闻。

sentences.en: Please, please,
sentences.zh: 请，请，

sentences.en: please feel free to dig deeper because there's a lot more information and there's a lot – and obviously a lot of our information was very much taking the character as a point of inspiration and then doing this big arch-villain version of him.
sentences.zh: 请随意深入挖掘，因为有很多信息，而且显然我们的很多信息非常多地将角色作为灵感的来源，然后制作了这个大反派版本。

sentences.en: You know, in the second season,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在第二季，

sentences.en: they spring a creature out of this dragon's cave underneath Central Park and literally the Tammany Tiger jumps out who is a giant – who is a giant blind tiger with, like,
sentences.zh: 他们从中央公园下面这个龙穴里放出了一个生物，字面上坦慕尼之虎跳了出来，它是一个巨大的——一个巨大的盲虎，带着，比如，

sentences.en: cuffs and a top hat with a shamrock on it.
sentences.zh: 袖扣和一顶上面有三叶草的高礼帽。

sentences.en: And you go, like – it's like – you know, but I would hope that people would not see that and then go, oh, Tammany Hall, that's where that tiger is, right?
sentences.zh: 你会说，就像——你知道，但我希望人们不会看到那个然后说，哦，坦慕尼协会，那只老虎就在那里，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 就像，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Coulson Whitehead wrote about this, that, you know, when he was growing up, the Underground Railroad was an actual railroad, like, in his mind.
sentences.zh: 科尔森·怀特黑德写过这个，你知道，当他成长时，地下铁路在他心中是一条真正的铁路。

sentences.en: Like, he could not escape that image.
sentences.zh: 就像，他无法逃避那个形象。

sentences.en: It's one of those things.
sentences.zh: 这是其中之一。

sentences.en: It's kind of funny how you get information like this.
sentences.zh: 你以这种方式获得信息真是太有趣了。

sentences.en: And I think it's awesome that people learn about Robert Moses through your show, you know, like, because – I mean, there's definitely a lot more to dig into.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们通过你们的节目了解罗伯特·摩西真是太棒了，你知道，因为——我的意思是，绝对还有很多值得挖掘的地方。

sentences.en: But it's just a great – like, you take this sort of gestalt of this big book and kind of go, well, these are the things that speak to me about this.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一个伟大的——就像，你采用这本书的这种格式塔，然后说，好吧，这些是关于这个对我说话的事情。

sentences.en: It's this idea of, you know, choice taken away from you and places being shaped for, you know, like, misguided and selfish reasons.
sentences.zh: 这是这个想法，你知道，选择从你手中夺走，地方被塑造，你知道，为了，比如，误导和自私的原因。

sentences.en: And, you know, it is a way to describe the world as it is.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是一种描述世界现状的方式。

sentences.en: It is – it's also – it's part of the irony of history that Robert Carroll feels the need to write this massive book,
sentences.zh: 这是——这也是——这是历史讽刺的一部分，罗伯特·卡罗觉得有必要写这本巨大的书，

sentences.en: this incredibly researched book in order to tear down the myth of Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 这本经过难以置信研究的书，为了推翻罗伯特·摩西的神话。

sentences.en: And now, 50 years later, there's people who are like, that was a real guy?
sentences.zh: 现在，50年后，有人说，那是一个真实的人？

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 哈？

sentences.en: Like, that's – like, Robert Moses was so omnipresent in New York that Robert Carroll had to marshal so much argument to show that he was not doing good work.
sentences.zh: 就像，那——就像，罗伯特·摩西在纽约无处不在，以至于罗伯特·卡罗不得不动用如此多的论据来证明他没有做好的工作。

sentences.en: And now the – it's so around the opposite where people just are like, oh, yeah, that's – yeah, that's that villain on that fantasy show, you know?
sentences.zh: 现在——这完全相反，人们只是说，哦，是的，那是——是的，那是那个奇幻节目里的恶棍，你知道？

sentences.en: I mean, that's a fascinating thing is the idea of Robert Carroll who – I mean, like, I can't think of a more – you know, we talk about the influence of Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个迷人的事情，罗伯特·卡罗的想法——我的意思是，就像，我想不出一个更——你知道，我们谈论罗伯特·摩西的影响。

sentences.en: The influence of Robert Carroll, I – growing up in New York, not one time did anyone ever go, you know, Bob Moses got a bad rap.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗的影响，我——在纽约长大，从来没有人说过，你知道，鲍勃·摩西受到了不公正的评价。

sentences.en: Like, no.
sentences.zh: 就像，没有。

sentences.en: Like, that book just decimated that guy.
sentences.zh: 就像，那本书彻底摧毁了那个人。

sentences.en: It moiterized him.
sentences.zh: 它让他名誉扫地。

sentences.en: He – the – I mean, Robert Carroll is the definitive last word on Robert Moses' legacy and to the degree that if people are unaware of Moses and become aware of him,
sentences.zh: 他——那个——我的意思是，罗伯特·卡罗是关于罗伯特·摩西遗产的最终定论，如果人们不知道摩西并开始了解他，

sentences.en: there is a degree of like the – probably the first thing you hear is some apocryphal boogeyman style story that sort of reflects or echoes something from the book.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，你可能听到的第一件事是一些杜撰的妖怪式故事，它反映或呼应了书中的某些内容。

sentences.en: Or at least that's been my experience with people finding out about him is they're like, oh, yeah, that's the guy.
sentences.zh: 或者至少这是我发现人们了解他时的经历，他们会说，哦，是的，就是那个人。

sentences.en: And like the first thing they'll tell you is one of the excoriating pieces of evidence from the book, right?
sentences.zh: 就像他们会告诉你的第一件事就是书中那些严厉的证据之一，对吧？

sentences.en: Rather than that's the man that built America, you know, or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 而不是那是建造美国的人，你知道，或类似的东西。

sentences.en: Jones Beach, Robert Moses?
sentences.zh: 琼斯海滩，罗伯特·摩西？

sentences.en: Jones Beach?
sentences.zh: 琼斯海滩？

sentences.en: So this is sort of the end of our series.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我们系列的结尾。

sentences.en: We're in the fall of Robert Moses, the fall from power.
sentences.zh: 我们处于罗伯特·摩西的秋天，权力的陨落。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: The loss of power.
sentences.zh: 权力的丧失。

sentences.en: The loss of power.
sentences.zh: 权力的丧失。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, so you have to wait till the evening to know how good the day has been.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你必须等到晚上才知道这一天过得有多好。

sentences.en: And we're getting into the evening.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进入夜晚。

sentences.en: Like the sun is sinking down.
sentences.zh: 就像太阳正在下沉。

sentences.en: We – you know, we have one more real summarizing episode left.
sentences.zh: 我们——你知道，我们还剩下一集真正的总结集。

sentences.en: And what's so fascinating about his fall is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 关于他的陨落，最迷人的是，你知道，

sentences.en: through some sort of machinations of like wanting to control the world's fair and therefore giving up some of his city posts and then, you know,
sentences.zh: 通过某种想要控制世界博览会的阴谋，因此放弃了他的一些城市职位，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: for the peak resigning as a bluff to his state posts.
sentences.zh: 为了巅峰，作为对他州职位的虚张声势而辞职。

sentences.en: And then finally, for the first time in decades, after doing that over and over again, Nelson Rockefeller like takes him up on it and he actually, you know,
sentences.zh: 最后，几十年来第一次，在一次又一次这样做之后，纳尔逊·洛克菲勒接受了他的辞职，他实际上，你知道，

sentences.en: gets forced out of his state posts.
sentences.zh: 被迫离开了他的州职位。

sentences.en: And it's a pretty – like a whimper, ignominious end to his reign.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当——就像呜咽一样，他统治的耻辱结局。

sentences.en: That is not how your Robert Moses beats his end.
sentences.zh: 那不是你的罗伯特·摩西结束的方式。

sentences.en: So – and in a way, it's satisfying because you see the beats of it.
sentences.zh: 所以——在某种程度上，这令人满意，因为你看到了它的节奏。

sentences.en: And so as a story, it's really fun to watch, you know, this resignation tactic finally not work.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个故事，看着这个辞职策略最终不起作用真的很有趣，你知道。

sentences.en: But it doesn't have the kind of like sort of oomph that you kind of want him.
sentences.zh: 但它没有那种你想要的冲击力。

sentences.en: So describe how they – the fight and, you know, how they ended Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 所以描述他们——战斗，你知道，他们是如何结束罗伯特·摩西的。

sentences.en: The big villainous scheme.
sentences.zh: 那个巨大的邪恶计划。

sentences.en: So it's very – I mean this is as animated and over the top as you can get.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常——我的意思是这就像动画一样夸张。

sentences.en: Robert Moses and his army of vampires – his army of vampire financiers concoct a ritual at the New York Stock Exchange, which our heroes are unable to stop on New Year's Eve.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·摩西和他的吸血鬼军队——他的吸血鬼金融家军队在纽约证券交易所策划了一个仪式，我们的英雄们在除夕夜无法阻止它。

sentences.en: And a disembodied Sauron-esque Robert Moses retreats to the ball drop in Times Square where as the ball drops, there's a lot of magic having to do with the Golden Door,
sentences.zh: 一个脱离肉体的索伦式的罗伯特·摩西撤退到时代广场的落球仪式，当球落下时，有很多与黄金之门有关的魔法，

sentences.en: Emma Lazarus, the New Colossus.
sentences.zh: 艾玛·拉撒路，《新巨人》。

sentences.en: And the idea that in order to like basically extend his sphere of influence from New York to the rest of the country, Robert Moses is going to summon the American dream.
sentences.zh: 以及这个想法，为了基本上将他的影响力范围从纽约扩展到全国其他地区，罗伯特·摩西要召唤美国梦。

sentences.en: He's going to summon the embodied version of the American dream.
sentences.zh: 他要召唤美国梦的化身版本。

sentences.en: And the danger of bringing a dream into the real world is that the second a dream becomes real, it becomes one thing.
sentences.zh: 把梦带入现实世界的危险在于，梦变成现实的那一秒，它就变成了一件事。

sentences.en: When you call a little wish or a figment into the waking world, it can become a spell, a moment, a flash, a joke, a little bit of joy.
sentences.zh: 当你把一个小愿望或一个虚构的东西带入清醒的世界时，它可以变成一个咒语、一个瞬间、一个闪光、一个笑话、一点点快乐。

sentences.en: There are dreams that are so large and important that they represent a threat to the cosmos if they are brought into the waking world.
sentences.zh: 有些梦是如此巨大和重要，如果它们被带入清醒的世界，它们就代表了对宇宙的威胁。

sentences.en: And while a dream is a dream, it can be anything.
sentences.zh: 当梦还是梦的时候，它可以是任何东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a lot of like fairy logic to that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这其中有很多仙界的逻辑。

sentences.en: But what I think it means more pointedly for Robert Moses as the master of concrete and steel and the idea of concretizing something is the idea that the American dream is at its strongest or best when it is interpretable.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，对于作为混凝土与钢铁大师的罗伯特·摩西而言，这种“具体化”的概念更深刻的含义在于：当美国梦具有可解读性时，它才最强大、最美好。

sentences.en: And where it means something different to everyone who wants to pursue it and by bringing it into the real world and putting it under his control,
sentences.zh: 它对每个想要追求它的人都有不同的意义，而通过将其带入现实世界并置于他的掌控之下，

sentences.en: he will forever kill every other version of it.
sentences.zh: 他将永远扼杀掉它的所有其他版本。

sentences.en: You see the tendrils of Robert's spell and the infection set in, the dream warps, convulses,
sentences.zh: 你可以看到罗伯特咒语的触须和感染开始蔓延，梦想扭曲、抽搐，

sentences.en: has its last moment where it could be anything and begins to take a solid stationary form.
sentences.zh: 在它还能成为任何事物的最后一刻，开始呈现出一种固定的、静止的形态。

sentences.en: A tall, clean-cut, square-jawed, blonde-haired, blue-eyed man appears hovering in the air above you.
sentences.zh: 一个高大、干练、方下巴、金发蓝眼的男人出现在你头顶的半空中。

sentences.en: It surveys what it can see, the city, the sidewalks, the subways, the buildings, the billboards.
sentences.zh: 它审视着所见的一切：城市、人行道、地铁、建筑、广告牌。

sentences.en: And then a resonant voice goes,
sentences.zh: 然后一个洪亮的声音响起：

sentences.en: Place is.
sentences.zh: “此地即是。”

sentences.en: So that poetry aside, all the good guys jump in a big tornado in Times Square and on a bunch of floating – this is where we move from the poetic into the insane and literal.
sentences.zh: 所以，抛开诗意不谈，所有好人都跳进了时代广场的一个大龙卷风里，还有一堆漂浮的——这就是我们从诗意转向疯狂和写实的地方。

sentences.en: They jump into a bunch of floating concrete sidewalk platforms, fight the American dream, defeat the spell that Robert Moses is casting,
sentences.zh: 他们跳上一堆漂浮的混凝土人行道平台，对抗美国梦，击败罗伯特·摩西施下的咒语，

sentences.en: and sunder him and break his stranglehold on the unsleeping city forevermore.
sentences.zh: 将他撕碎，永远打破他对这座不眠之城的扼制。

sentences.en: And send the American dream back through the golden door into the land of dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 并将美国梦送回黄金之门，回到梦境之地。

sentences.en: You glow with the power of the chosen one.
sentences.zh: 你沐浴在天选之人的力量中闪闪发光。

sentences.en: And the frozen flame flies back into the golden door.
sentences.zh: 冰封的火焰飞回了黄金之门。

sentences.en: Robert screams,
sentences.zh: 罗伯特尖叫着，

sentences.en: And that's the final battle.
sentences.zh: 这就是最终决战。

sentences.en: And it is a lot – I will say it is a lot more final than the accepting of a resignation.
sentences.zh: 这确实很——我得说，这比接受辞职要“最终”得多。

sentences.en: You know, that's for sure, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是肯定的，对吧？

sentences.en: So if you end the book, reading the book, and you're like,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你读完了这本书，然后你会觉得，

sentences.en: I really wanted something – you know, I really wanted a good punch to the nose of Robert Moses here.
sentences.zh: “我真的很想要点什么——你知道，我真的很想在这里给罗伯特·摩西的鼻子来上一拳。”

sentences.en: You can read the 51st chapter, which would be The Unsleeping City.
sentences.zh: 你可以读读第51章，也就是《不眠之城》。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Dropout.tv.
sentences.zh: Dropout.tv.

sentences.en: And I will say this.
sentences.zh: 我还要说一点。

sentences.en: We have a lot more spells.
sentences.zh: 我们还有更多的咒语。

sentences.en: There's also a tiny little fairy mobster called Don Confetti.
sentences.zh: 还有一个叫“五彩纸屑教父”的小精灵黑帮头目。

sentences.en: And he talks like this.
sentences.zh: 他说话是这样的。

sentences.en: So where's that, Robert Caro?
sentences.zh: 那么那部分在哪儿呢，罗伯特·卡罗？

sentences.en: Where's that in the book?
sentences.zh: 书里哪儿有这个？

sentences.en: I ask you.
sentences.zh: 我问你。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So when you presented Robert Moses to your dream team, who are your players, did they know who Robert Moses was?
sentences.zh: 那么，当你向你的梦之队介绍罗伯特·摩西时，你的玩家们知道罗伯特·摩西是谁吗？

sentences.en: Or did you know – like, did you know their level of familiarity with the character in the real world?
sentences.zh: 或者说，你知道——比如，你知道他们在现实世界中对这个角色的熟悉程度吗？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I did – the crew knew, obviously.
sentences.zh: 我——剧组当然知道。

sentences.en: The people that I've been working with, you know, developing the storyline knew.
sentences.zh: 和我一起工作、开发故事情节的人，你知道，他们是知道的。

sentences.en: But yeah, I believe that a couple of them did actually know that Robert Moses was a real historical figure.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我相信他们中确实有几个人知道罗伯特·摩西是一个真实的历史人物。

sentences.en: And did that change the way that different people interacted with him?
sentences.zh: 那这是否改变了不同人与他互动的方式？

sentences.en: You know, because you're all telling the story together.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为你们是在一起讲故事。

sentences.en: And you have a master plan and a guide.
sentences.zh: 而且你有一个总体规划和指南。

sentences.en: Not an un-Moses-like master plan for how they're going to navigate this space, this story that you're telling.
sentences.zh: 这和你所讲述的这个空间、这个故事的导航方式，倒也颇有几分“摩西式”的总体规划意味。

sentences.en: But they do have input.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实有投入。

sentences.en: And did you notice that different characters interacted with the villain Moses differently if, you know,
sentences.zh: 你有没有注意到，如果不同的角色对纽约以及他所做的事情更熟悉，他们与反派摩西的互动方式会有所不同？

sentences.en: they were more familiar with New York and what he did and that sort of thing?
sentences.zh: 我是说，那种情况。

sentences.en: I just wonder if there was any sort of breakdown of that.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇是否会有这种差异。

sentences.en: I think what's interesting is the awareness came out in the midst of the season.
sentences.zh: 我觉得有趣的是，这种认知是在这一季进行过程中出现的。

sentences.en: So it was not like a difference between cast members in that some immediately clocked him and some didn't.
sentences.zh: 所以并不是演员之间存在差异，导致有些人立刻认出了他，而有些人没有。

sentences.en: It was more that as the season was shooting and it was clear that this was a real historical figure, that pointedness, I think, developed more.
sentences.zh: 更多的情况是，随着这一季的拍摄，当大家清楚这是一个真实的历史人物时，那种针对性，我认为，变得更加明显了。

sentences.en: To the point where, you know, I think that final confrontation at the Met, there's a really great part of it where Lou's character, Kingston, has basically heard enough.
sentences.zh: 以至于，你知道，我认为在大都会博物馆的那场最终对峙中，有一个非常棒的部分，卢的角色金斯顿基本上已经受够了。

sentences.en: That there's a sort of silence or gravitas to that scene where knowing how – just again, like, you know,
sentences.zh: 那场戏有一种沉默或庄重感，因为知道——再次强调，你知道，

sentences.en: the sort of horrifying power that this man wielded and his utter remorselessness for the most marginalized communities that were impacted over and over and over again for decades.
sentences.zh: 这个男人所挥舞的那种可怕的力量，以及他对于那些几十年来一次又一次受到影响的最边缘化社区的彻底冷酷无情。

sentences.en: I think that there was a degree of gravitas that is added by that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这增加了一种庄重感。

sentences.en: And there's this weird delineation, I think, in storytelling,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在讲故事中存在一种奇怪的界限，

sentences.en: especially fantasy storytelling where villains either are misunderstood and they have a point and they're three-dimensional or they're like Mwahaha, like Maleficent, you know,
sentences.zh: 特别是在奇幻故事中，反派要么是被误解的，他们有自己的道理，是立体的；要么就像玛琳菲森那样，你知道，

sentences.en: I am arch evil.
sentences.zh: “我是邪恶的化身”。

sentences.en: And I weirdly think that you get some of both worlds in an instance where there's nothing more three-dimensional than a real human being, but it almost makes it worse.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我觉得你在这种情况下两者兼得，没有什么比一个真实的人更立体的了，但这反而让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: You know, like the idea that someone had a complex inner life and had emotional wrinkles and depth to themselves and was this heartless for this long,
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如一个人拥有复杂的内心生活，有情感的褶皱和深度，却能如此冷酷地持续这么久，

sentences.en: wielding this much power is astonishing.
sentences.zh: 挥舞着如此巨大的权力，这令人震惊。

sentences.en: And I think that the – so the PCs, as they were clocking that, I actually think it gave them a measure of resolve even as the villain was not a total cartoon, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我认为——所以当玩家们意识到这一点时，我实际上认为这给了他们一种决心，即使反派并不是一个完全的卡通人物，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm just going to, like, add a little annotation here that PCs in this context is player characters, right?
sentences.zh: 我只是想在这里加一个小注，在这个语境下，PC是指玩家角色，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A PC is a player character, yes.
sentences.zh: PC就是玩家角色，没错。

sentences.en: So that means that that's part of the group of this collective storytelling game enterprise that you're telling me.
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着这是你告诉我的那个集体讲故事游戏企业的一部分。

sentences.en: For folks who's turning it – and I'm sure – and again, if you're listening to, you know, 99% Invisible breaking down the power broker, I'm sure you've played tons of D&D.
sentences.zh: 对于那些正在转向它的人——我敢肯定——再说一次，如果你正在收听《99%隐形》对《权力掮客》的剖析，我敢肯定你玩过很多龙与地下城（D&D）。

sentences.en: I'm sure that is – they have, right?
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定那是——他们玩过，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it's a decent crossover.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这是一个不错的交叉点。

sentences.en: There's probably plenty who don't – who are just, like, into history stuff.
sentences.zh: 可能有很多不玩的人——只是喜欢历史方面的东西。

sentences.en: We were debating this of how much to describe what D&D is because obviously there's, like – you know, there's different sections of the world who know different things for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在争论要描述多少关于D&D的内容，因为显然——你知道，世界上有不同的人群，他们确实了解不同的事情。

sentences.en: But, for example, when I was talking to my kids, I have twin 17-year-olds who are very into D&D, and I mentioned that I was going to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 但例如，当我跟我孩子谈话时，我有一对17岁的双胞胎，他们非常喜欢D&D，我提到我要和你谈话。

sentences.en: And I said, are you familiar with, you know, Brendan Lee Mulligan's work?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们熟悉布伦丹·李·穆里根的作品吗？

sentences.en: And they were like, he's only the greatest DM in the world probably of all time.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他可能是世界上有史以来最伟大的地下城主（DM）。

sentences.en: You know, like –
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像——

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That's so sweet.
sentences.zh: 太贴心了。

sentences.en: That's very kind.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, so, like, they're the people who know both because I talk about the power broker endlessly, and they watched Unsleeping City as it came out, like I was aware of it,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，他们是那种两者都了解的人，因为我没完没了地谈论《权力掮客》，而且他们在《不眠之城》播出时就看了，就像我意识到它一样，

sentences.en: you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道。

sentences.en: Wow, wow, wow.
sentences.zh: 哇，哇，哇。

sentences.en: That's incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: So when you're devising something as complex as Unsleeping City, and you have some designs where you want to lead them, but they have their own agency to a certain degree,
sentences.zh: 所以当你设计像《不眠之城》这样复杂的东西时，你有一些想要引导他们的设计，但他们在一定程度上又有自己的能动性，

sentences.en: how do you balance that when you're telling something that's complex and, like, the idea of the highway hacks and the American dream and stuff, it's a complex idea.
sentences.zh: 当你讲述一些复杂的事情，比如高速公路黑客和美国梦之类的东西时，你是如何平衡的？这是一个复杂的想法。

sentences.en: So at least they seem to me to be that way.
sentences.zh: 至少在我看来是这样。

sentences.en: How do you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I feel, I feel, Roman, that I'm being set up for an analogy where this very much mirrors Robert Moses.
sentences.zh: 罗曼，我觉得我被设下了一个类比的陷阱，这非常像罗伯特·摩西。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: And I want to tell you that I see the trap.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你，我看到了这个陷阱。

sentences.en: I see that you're laying it out here.
sentences.zh: 我看到你在这里铺设它了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm on to you, man.
sentences.zh: 我识破你了，伙计。

sentences.en: That was very smart of you.
sentences.zh: 你刚才那招很聪明。

sentences.en: That's why you're a good DM.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你是个好DM。

sentences.en: You can see the game behind his DMing in this interview.
sentences.zh: 你可以在这次采访中看到他DM背后的游戏。

sentences.en: I see the game, man.
sentences.zh: 我看到了这个游戏，伙计。

sentences.en: No, but you're very right.
sentences.zh: 不，但你说得很对。

sentences.en: There is a fascinating – well, I think that the – in the language that Robert Moses uses a lot to talk about, you know, when he's talking about, like,
sentences.zh: 有一个迷人的——嗯，我认为——在罗伯特·摩西谈论很多事情时所使用的语言中，你知道，当他谈论，比如，

sentences.en: Long Island and he's talking about, like, what are the kinds of people we want to attract, right?
sentences.zh: 长岛，当他谈论，比如，我们想要吸引什么样的人时，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, that's the language he uses, but there is a, like,
sentences.zh: 就像，那是他使用的语言，但有一种，比如，

sentences.en: a darkness and a cynicism when you understand that individual freedom written over massive populations and a powerful incentive structure is fate.
sentences.zh: 一种黑暗和愤世嫉俗，当你明白个人自由在庞大人口和强大的激励结构之上被书写时，那就是命运。

sentences.en: Free will over the aggregate becomes fate when you incentivize strongly enough, and that's really sad,
sentences.zh: 当激励足够强烈时，总体的自由意志就会变成命运，这真的很可悲，

sentences.en: and it challenges a lot of our deeply held ideas about the power of individual freedom.
sentences.zh: 它挑战了我们许多关于个人自由力量的根深蒂固的观念。

sentences.en: And so you – to answer your question, on a DMing level, sadly, it's the same – it's the same necromancy.
sentences.zh: 所以你——回答你的问题，在DM层面，可悲的是，这是同样的——这是同样的死灵术。

sentences.en: It's the same magic where you go – you are kind of building these tracks.
sentences.zh: 这是同样的魔法，你走过去——你有点像是在铺设这些轨道。

sentences.en: You're building this thing where you go, okay, you can do whatever you want, but I know what you want.
sentences.zh: 你正在建立这个东西，你走过去说，好吧，你可以做任何你想做的事，但我知道你想要什么。

sentences.en: So if I build – it's like – it's sort of – there's – when people are seeking a stimulus, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以如果我建立——这就像——这有点——当人们在寻求刺激时，你知道，

sentences.en: it's like – it would be – this is such a – this is – I don't mean this as a disparagement of players, but to use a metaphor that there's, like,
sentences.zh: 这就像——这会是——我并不是要把这当作对玩家的贬低，但使用一个比喻，就像，

sentences.en: you have cheese at the end of the maze.
sentences.zh: 你在迷宫尽头放了奶酪。

sentences.en: You don't have to seal off the maze.
sentences.zh: 你不需要封锁迷宫。

sentences.en: You don't have to trap anyone in the maze if you know that they're looking for the cheese, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你知道他们在寻找奶酪，你就不需要把任何人困在迷宫里，对吧？

sentences.en: There's this element of when you're building adventures and you're building even these complex ideas in there, you make something very personal.
sentences.zh: 当你构建冒险，甚至在其中构建这些复杂的想法时，有一个要素，就是你创造了一些非常私人的东西。

sentences.en: You make something where it's like, well, this person has this villainous ideology, and that ideology has resulted in concrete harm to a loved one,
sentences.zh: 你创造了一些东西，比如，这个人有这种邪恶的意识形态，而那种意识形态导致了对所爱之人的具体伤害，

sentences.en: or it's resulted in something that is very visceral and felt to my character.
sentences.zh: 或者它导致了一些对我角色来说非常直观和深刻的东西。

sentences.en: And the PC – the best way, honestly, to create these story structures is in collaboration with your players,
sentences.zh: 而PC——老实说，创造这些故事结构的最好方法是与你的玩家合作，

sentences.en: which doesn't mean that you're pre-writing what the story is going to be.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你预先写好了故事会是什么样。

sentences.en: But there's this beautiful – when I talk to, like,
sentences.zh: 但有一种美妙的——当我与，比如，

sentences.en: novice dungeon masters about how to construct adventures and flow sheets and sequences of events that your friends will feel compelled to improvise through,
sentences.zh: 新手地下城主谈论如何构建冒险、流程图和事件序列，让你的朋友们感到被迫去即兴发挥时，

sentences.en: it's always the idea of the motivation and heart of your players as they're embodying these characters has force and inertia to it.
sentences.zh: 这总是关于玩家在体现这些角色时的动机和内心的想法，它具有力量和惯性。

sentences.en: It's like water flowing downhill.
sentences.zh: 这就像水往低处流。

sentences.en: You can irrigate a hillside to know where the water is going to go, and it's not a reflection on the water doing what you told it to.
sentences.zh: 你可以灌溉山坡以了解水会流向哪里，这并不是反映水在做你告诉它的事。

sentences.en: It's a reflection on you understand that these people are pursuing their aims rationally.
sentences.zh: 这反映了你理解这些人正在理性地追求他们的目标。

sentences.en: And if they're pursuing their aims rationally, you can create the structures that direct those aiMs.
sentences.zh: 如果他们理性地追求目标，你就可以创造出引导这些目标的结构。

sentences.en: Brennan, you're not going to like this, but talking about knowing what people want and using that as leverage to get them to do what you want them to, sounds like power brokering,
sentences.zh: 布伦南，你不会喜欢这个，但谈论了解人们想要什么并利用它作为杠杆让他们做你想让他们做的事，听起来像是权力掮客，

sentences.en: to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: No, man.
sentences.zh: 不，伙计。

sentences.en: Sounds like you're doing a lot of power brokering.
sentences.zh: 听起来你在做很多权力掮客的事。

sentences.en: Come on, man.
sentences.zh: 得了吧，伙计。

sentences.en: Don't do this to me, dude.
sentences.zh: 别这样对我，老兄。

sentences.en: You can't do this to me.
sentences.zh: 你不能这样对我。

sentences.en: It's almost like DM stands for Dungeon Moses.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像DM代表“地下城摩西”。

sentences.en: Hold on a second.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: Suddenly, my disguise fades away.
sentences.zh: 突然，我的伪装消失了。

sentences.en: I'm like, curse his, and I fly out.
sentences.zh: 我就像，诅咒他，然后我飞走了。

sentences.en: It was him the whole time.
sentences.zh: 一直都是他。

sentences.en: It was him the whole time.
sentences.zh: 一直都是他。

sentences.en: It's very – yeah.
sentences.zh: 这非常——是的。

sentences.en: It's a very – I don't know.
sentences.zh: 这非常——我不知道。

sentences.en: It's genuinely a joy and a privilege to be able to write these kinds of stories.
sentences.zh: 能够写出这类故事确实是一种快乐和特权。

sentences.en: And I think, too, like in our first season, Robert Mose was such like a fun, compelling villain for the historicity and how much like history mattered and was important.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，就像在我们的第一季中，罗伯特·摩西作为一个有趣、引人注目的反派，对于历史性以及历史有多么重要和关键来说，是多么重要。

sentences.en: And I think, too, in the second season that we did as well, urban fantasy is so interesting in that you're often depicting – both at the same time,
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，在我们做的第二季中，都市奇幻之所以如此有趣，是因为你经常在描绘——同时描绘两件事，

sentences.en: you're depicting the heightened fantastical reality as well as the – what is actually the mundane reality on the ground.
sentences.zh: 你既在描绘高度奇幻的现实，也在描绘——地面上实际的世俗现实。

sentences.en: You know, like our second season, we had sort of a large company called Gladiator that was trying to open a campus in Queens.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像我们的第二季，我们有一个大型公司叫“角斗士”，它试图在皇后区开设一个园区。

sentences.en: And there was like – this was around the – you know, this idea of like a big conglomerate shipping e-commerce company.
sentences.zh: 这就像——这是围绕着——你知道，这种大型企业航运电子商务公司的想法。

sentences.en: And it was summoning this extra-dimensional being called Null.
sentences.zh: 它正在召唤一个叫“虚无”的超维度存在。

sentences.en: And that season was very much about kind of the emptiness and urban isolation of hyper-consumerist capitalism, right?
sentences.zh: 而那一季非常关注超消费资本主义的空虚和城市孤立，对吧？

sentences.en: And so you're depicting these things where there's this haunting entity in the dream world that's coming out of – it's like a faceless, colorless silhouette, very Lovecraftian.
sentences.zh: 所以你正在描绘这些东西，梦境世界中有一个萦绕不去的实体，它来自——就像一个无面、无色的剪影，非常洛夫克拉夫特式。

sentences.en: But then also you're looking at like an apartment complex with no one living in it because all of the apartments have been purchased as basically asset class investments, you know,
sentences.zh: 但同时你也在看一个没有人居住的公寓大楼，因为所有的公寓都被当作资产类投资购买了，你知道，

sentences.en: like – which I think there's some crazy percentage of apartments on Central Park that are vacant for like more than 80 percent of the year, right?
sentences.zh: 就像——我认为中央公园有相当大比例的公寓一年中有超过80%的时间是空置的，对吧？

sentences.en: And so it's a – it's a bizarre – it's a fun thing in crafting these stories,
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个——这是一个奇怪的——在创作这些故事时是一件有趣的事情，

sentences.en: especially in any kind of setting like The Unsleeping City that's so contingent on the real world and is very much depicting that where you're like here's the metaphor and here's the reality and here's both of them hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 特别是在像《不眠之城》这样非常依赖现实世界、非常真实地描绘现实的设定中，你会觉得这就是隐喻，这就是现实，两者手拉手并存。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like it's not just the analogy.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是个类比。

sentences.en: The analogy is like here with this other component that is real.
sentences.zh: 这个类比就像是把另一个真实存在的组件放在这里。

sentences.en: It's a joy.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种享受。

sentences.en: It's a real privilege to be able to get these kind of – tell these kind of stories.
sentences.zh: 能讲述这类故事，真是一种莫大的荣幸。

sentences.en: And speaking of New York, we'll be coming to Madison Square Garden in January, which is nuts.
sentences.zh: 说到纽约，我们一月份要去麦迪逊广场花园演出，这简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: We – the Dimension 20 is going to be performing January 24th at Madison Square Garden.
sentences.zh: 我们——Dimension 20 将于1月24日在麦迪逊广场花园进行表演。

sentences.en: We sold out the garden.
sentences.zh: 我们的票卖光了。

sentences.en: So it's a –
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个——

sentences.en: Congratulations.
sentences.zh: 恭喜。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It's nuts.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's nuts.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Well, I mean thank you so much for being on the 99% Invisible Breakdown of The Power Broker.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢你能来参加《99% Invisible》对《权力掮客》的深度解析。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure and it was really – it's just fun.
sentences.zh: 这真是太愉快了，而且真的——非常有趣。

sentences.en: I hope people like who are interested in D&D or even if you're not, just like check out the season, watch it unfold.
sentences.zh: 我希望那些对《龙与地下城》感兴趣的人，或者即使你不感兴趣，也能去看看这一季，看看故事如何展开。

sentences.en: It's a really fun take on the underlying concepts and values of the book.
sentences.zh: 这是对书中核心概念和价值观的一种非常有趣的解读。

sentences.en: You know, it's just – this is great.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真是——太棒了。

sentences.en: You added to the canon.
sentences.zh: 你为这部经典之作增添了新的内容。

sentences.en: And thank you for using your medium to spread the word of Robert Moses and The Power Broker to those who were previously not aware of it but are pretty interested in digging into lore.
sentences.zh: 也感谢你利用自己的媒体平台，向那些之前并不了解但对挖掘背景知识很感兴趣的人传播罗伯特·摩西和《权力掮客》的故事。

sentences.en: So I think they're going to enjoy The Power Broker when they finally get to it.
sentences.zh: 所以我相信他们最终读到《权力掮客》时会很喜欢的。

sentences.en: I'll say if you love lore, Robert Carrow's The Power Broker is chock full of lore, my friends.
sentences.zh: 我得说，如果你喜欢背景知识，罗伯特·卡罗的《权力掮客》里全是干货，朋友们。

sentences.en: It's chock full of lore.
sentences.zh: 全是干货。

sentences.en: That's how we make a difference.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们做出改变的方式。

sentences.en: We start referring to history as lore.
sentences.zh: 我们开始把历史称为“背景知识（lore）”。

sentences.en: We're going to get a bunch of people.
sentences.zh: 我们会吸引一大批人。

sentences.en: It's truly a pleasure and an honor to be on the podcast today and I really hope that anyone who is coming here from Dimension 20 digs into not only the rest of The Power Broker but the rest of 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 今天能来参加这个播客节目真是我的荣幸，我真心希望那些从Dimension 20过来的人，不仅能深入阅读《权力掮客》的其余部分，也能去听听《99% Invisible》的其他节目。

sentences.en: All the things that I talked about that matter to me, I feel very much like if I can do anything as a comedian and storyteller to like direct people towards these things.
sentences.zh: 我谈到的所有对我来说重要的事情，我觉得如果我能以喜剧演员和讲故事的人的身份做点什么，去引导人们关注这些事情，那就太好了。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: learning about Robert Moses as the villainous arcane architect of the highway hex is hopefully step one on people digging into not only the history of Robert Moses in New York but the people wherever you live,
sentences.zh: 了解罗伯特·摩西作为“公路诅咒”的邪恶神秘建筑师，希望这是人们深入挖掘的起点，不仅是挖掘罗伯特·摩西在纽约的历史，还有你所在地方的人们，

sentences.en: the city that you're in and who is shaping the environs of your life.
sentences.zh: 你所在的城市，以及是谁在塑造你生活的环境。

sentences.en: And is there a way to get active in resisting whatever highway hex is being implemented in your town right now?
sentences.zh: 有没有办法积极行动起来，抵制你所在城镇目前正在实施的任何“公路诅咒”？

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: Well said.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: Next month, and I cannot believe what I am saying right now, we are going to be finishing the book.
sentences.zh: 下个月，我简直不敢相信我正在说的话，我们要读完这本书了。

sentences.en: Forget page numbers.
sentences.zh: 别管页码了。

sentences.en: Just read it till the end.
sentences.zh: 一直读到最后就行。

sentences.en: Read the book till there's nothing left in it to read anymore.
sentences.zh: 把书读到没东西可读为止。

sentences.en: We're there, people.
sentences.zh: 我们到了，各位。

sentences.en: It's the homestretch.
sentences.zh: 这是最后冲刺阶段了。

sentences.en: And if you can't wait till next month to hear my voice summarizing something, why not turn to the Flophouse podcast where we never reach the end.
sentences.zh: 如果你等不及下个月听我总结内容，为什么不去听听《Flophouse》播客呢？我们在那里永远读不完。

sentences.en: There's always more bad movies to talk about.
sentences.zh: 总有更多烂片可以聊。

sentences.en: It's an unending torment.
sentences.zh: 这是一种无尽的折磨。

sentences.zh: 我们准备了一堆《99% Invisible》版《权力掮客》的周边商品，祝贺你们坚持到了现在。

sentences.en: There are t-shirts, there are bags, there are bookmarks, and something that we've been waiting to tell you about.
sentences.zh: 有T恤、包袋、书签，还有一样我们一直等着告诉你们的东西。

sentences.zh: 我们有《99% Invisible》版《权力掮客》挑战币。

sentences.zh: 这是一枚纪念币。

sentences.zh: 完全是《权力掮客》主题的。

sentences.zh: 这是一个奖品，你可以拿出来向所有人展示你已经读完了《权力掮客》。

sentences.zh: 因为你以后再也不用像背着图腾一样背着《权力掮客》这本书到处走了，你知道的。

sentences.en: And you'll now have this coin to commemorate that you are a true Power Broker nerd.
sentences.zh: 现在你有了这枚硬币，来纪念你是一个真正的《权力掮客》书呆子。

sentences.en: The coins will be in the store soon.
sentences.zh: 硬币很快就会上架商店。

sentences.en: If they're not there already by the time this episode comes out, just head to 99PI.org slash store to get one.
sentences.zh: 如果这期节目发布时还没上架，直接去 99PI.org/store 买一个就行。

sentences.zh: 你可以在所有常见的社交媒体网站上找到我们的节目，也可以加入我们的Discord服务器，我们在那里愉快地讨论《权力掮客》、建筑，
